name: Microsoft Calendar
description: Find, create, update, answer and delete events in Outlook calendars, and find times that suit everyone.

timeOf.description: A Graph time (UTC, as requested) as ISO text: a date for all-day events.

graphTime.description: An ISO date or date-time as a Graph time in UTC; all-day events start and end at midnight.
graphTime.body: value == undefined ? undefined : {dateTime: allDay || length(value) == 10 ? substring(value, 0, 10) + 'T00:00:00' : substring(date(value), 0, 19), timeZone: 'UTC'}

personOf.description: A Graph emailAddress as { name, address }.
personOf.body: e == undefined ? undefined : compactObject({name: e.name, address: e.address})

attendeesOf.description: Graph attendees from required and optional address lists.
attendeesOf.body:
required == undefined && optional == undefined ? undefined : concat(
                map(default(required, []), a => {type: 'required', emailAddress: {address: a}}),
                map(default(optional, []), a => {type: 'optional', emailAddress: {address: a}})
            )

eventOf.body:
{
                id: e.id,
                subject: e.subject,
                preview: e.bodyPreview,
                start: timeOf(e.start, e.isAllDay),
                end: timeOf(e.end, e.isAllDay),
                allDay: default(e.isAllDay, false),
                location: ifEmpty(e.location.displayName, undefined),
                organizer: personOf(e.organizer.emailAddress),
                attendees: map(default(e.attendees, []), a => compactObject({name: a.emailAddress.name, address: a.emailAddress.address, type: a.type, response: a.status.response})),
                onlineMeeting: default(e.isOnlineMeeting, false),
                joinUrl: e.onlineMeeting.joinUrl,
                showAs: e.showAs,
                cancelled: default(e.isCancelled, false),
                myResponse: e.responseStatus.response,
                webLink: e.webLink,
                seriesMasterId: e.seriesMasterId,
                type: e.type,
                categories: default(e.categories, []),
                importance: e.importance,
                created: e.createdDateTime,
                updated: e.lastModifiedDateTime
            } | compactObject

auth.label: Sign in with Microsoft
auth.setup:
1. In the Microsoft Entra admin center, open **App registrations** and create a **New registration**. Choose who may sign in (any organization and personal accounts suit `tenant: common`).
2. Under **Authentication**, add a **Web** platform with your Conduit callback URL (for example `https://app.example/conduit/auth/callback`) as a redirect URI.
3. Under **Certificates & secrets**, create a **client secret**.
4. Under **API permissions**, add the Microsoft Graph *delegated* permissions `offline_access`, `User.Read`, `Calendars.ReadWrite`.
5. Give the application (client) id and secret to Conduit: `createConduit({ clients: { 'microsoft-calendar': { id, secret } } })`. To limit sign-in to one organization, set `config: { 'microsoft-calendar': { tenant: '<tenant id or domain>' } }`.

operations.label: Find meeting times
operations.description: Times within a window when the attendees (and you) are free, best first.
operations.output: {{compactObject({ suggestions: map(default(response.body.meetingTimeSuggestions, []), s => compactObject({ start: timeOf(s.meetingTimeSlot.start, false), end: timeOf(s.meetingTimeSlot.end, false), confidence: s.confidence, attendees: map(default(s.attendeeAvailability, []), a => {address: a.attendee.emailAddress.address, availability: a.availability}) })), emptyReason: ifEmpty(response.body.emptySuggestionsReason, undefined) })}}

operations.label: Get free/busy
operations.description: When people or rooms are busy between two times.
operations.output: {{map(default(response.body.value, []), v => compactObject({ address: v.scheduleId, busy: map(filter(default(v.scheduleItems, []), i => i.status != 'free'), i => {start: timeOf(i.start, false), end: timeOf(i.end, false), status: i.status}), error: v.error.message }))}}
